assertions.assertion: Program.cs includes MigrationsAssembly set to the current project assembly in both store configurations
assertions.rationale: Both AddConfigurationStore and AddOperationalStore call sql.MigrationsAssembly(migrationsAssembly), where migrationsAssembly = typeof(Program).Assembly.GetName().Name.

assertions.assertion: The response includes a dotnet ef migrations add command with -c ConfigurationDbContext
assertions.rationale: Includes dotnet ef migrations add InitialIdentityServerConfigurationDbMigration -c ConfigurationDbContext.

assertions.assertion: The response includes a dotnet ef migrations add command with -c PersistedGrantDbContext
assertions.rationale: Includes dotnet ef migrations add InitialIdentityServerPersistedGrantDbMigration -c PersistedGrantDbContext.

assertions.assertion: The response includes dotnet ef database update commands for both contexts
assertions.rationale: Includes dotnet ef database update -c PersistedGrantDbContext and -c ConfigurationDbContext.
